candidates.name: warm-cool
candidates.intent: one light direction, with the shadow ramp pulled toward blue and the highlight ramp toward yellow
candidates.treatment: directional ramp plus explicit warm/cool ramps

candidates.name: dither-band
candidates.intent: a two-tone surface whose band boundary is dithered, so the falloff reads as a gradient at 1x
candidates.treatment: directional ramp, then a checkerboard mix across each band edge

candidates.name: engine-deband
candidates.intent: engine-banded falloff that the engine itself dithers, so the band edge is not a hard line
candidates.treatment: flat paint, ramp_fill with three bands, then the deband pass

candidates.name: selective
candidates.intent: a selective outline: dark where the form turns away, light where it faces the light
candidates.treatment: auto-outline removed; per-cell rim chosen by which neighbour is empty

candidates.name: hue-shift
candidates.intent: an outline tinted toward the material's own hue instead of black, so edges belong to the surface
candidates.treatment: auto-outline colour points at a dark navy family rather than ink

candidates.name: hierarchy
candidates.intent: three edge treatments: dark silhouette, mid-tone detail lines, and no outline inside a mass
candidates.treatment: interior outline tones lifted to the mid tone; silhouette outline kept

candidates.name: hue-ramp
candidates.intent: ramps that step in hue as well as value: shadows run cool, highlights run warm
candidates.treatment: explicit ramps with a wider hue arc, no change to tone assignment

candidates.name: accent
candidates.intent: one saturated accent against quiet surroundings, so the palette has a focal point
candidates.treatment: wood and metal desaturated; the lock ramp saturated and widened

candidates.name: nonlinear
candidates.intent: a ramp weighted toward the darks, so form reads with few tones and the highlight stays small
